comment: Menu item names and their choices read from Meander.cpp, ModeScaleQuant.cpp and ModeScaleProgressions.cpp on the maker's master-V2 branch, which matches the installed 2.0.35. Each label is padded with trailing spaces in the source and each choice with two leading spaces; the lines drop both. Scale Out Mode has FOUR choices, not the three an earlier draft of this entry gave. Panel Theme, its light and dark items and the Contrast slider are carried by all three modules and are cosmetic, so they get no line. ModeScaleQuant has no Gate Out Mode and no Harmonic Degree Output Range. Both composers set running to true at construction, which is what the run note rests on.
